notes: Customer: small team (founder + 3 devs) building 'IvyBox' as a lightweight helpdesk for Shopify merchants.
Why Redwood? — wants predictable latency and clear per-token economics for a self-serve workflow. 'We don't want surprises on bills; need easy local testing first.'
Primary asks: 1) function-calling examples to automagically fill Zendesk fields; 2) JSON schema for summary + extraction; 3) cost leak overview for bursty weekend traffic.
Latency target: median < 500ms for 1–2 sentence summaries; throughput targets modest (10–40 reqs/sec peak).
Model preference: open models or quantized variants; happy to start with small Llama-family weights if performance/cost tradeoffs look good.
Security: must support SSO for admin portal, basic audit logs, and a simple retention toggle; data residency is a question for EU customers but initial POC is NA-only.
Quote from founder: 'We need a frictionless dev experience + clear examples for function-calling. If the quickstart works, we'll onboard pay-as-you-go.'
Integration note: current infra uses AWS Lambda + API Gateway -> Zendesk API; they'd like Redwood hosted API to handle parsing + function-calling to reduce Lambda logic.
Risk: very price sensitive — will evaluate monthly usage once POC runs; likely to churn if costs escalate beyond projections.
